text: These bastards 'round here won't let us go.
zh: 这儿的混蛋们不肯放我们走。

text: We were just looking for someone up here, and suddenly they knocked our heads in!
zh: 我们只是上来找个人，他们却突然把我们打得头破血流！

text: What should I do to get you out of here?
zh: 我该怎么做才能把你们弄出去？

text: Well, how about getting us out of here?!
zh: 那么，把我们弄出去怎么样？！

text: Talk to Balder. He has to know that Goran is keeping us here.
zh: 去找巴尔德谈谈。得让他知道戈兰把我们关在这儿。

text: You could talk to Goran as well, I guess, but I don't see that conversation being fruitful.
zh: 我猜你也可以去跟戈兰谈，不过我看那谈不出什么结果。

text: You can't just leave us here, man!
zh: 老兄，你不能就这么把我们丢在这儿！

text: How did you manage to get us out of here?
zh: 你是怎么把我们弄出来的？

text: Anyway, we will be heading to Balder's camp right away.
zh: 总之，我们这就动身去巴尔德的营地。
